entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Congrats on surviving midterms.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *sigh* I think I'm screwed for real this[n]time. I couldn't concentrate at all...

entries.speaker: Speech from Outside
entries.en: —gathering everyone's opinions and[n]immediately acting upon them...

entries.speaker: Speech from Outside
entries.en: In order to make that natural course of[n]action a reality, I will—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, again? It's so damn loud!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: More importantly, what's this you want to[n]talk about?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You said that something was on your[n]mind before, but were you able to[n]figure out what it was?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The Medjed that I banned...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...wasn't the real one.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Aren't you the real one though?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh, uhh...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The guy who called himself Medjed[n]after me isn't the one from the other[n]day!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The code written by that guy the other day[n]is different from any of the past Medjed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And that means...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A code is like your fingerprints. No matter[n]how you try to disguise it, your own quirks[n]appear in it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The one from the other day was all cut[n]and pasted with no consistency. No skill[n]at all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But aren't there multiple people across[n]the world that are part of Medjed?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Couldn't it have been done by someone[n]that joined recently?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: How do I put it? That code was so not[n]done by anyone interested in cracking.[n]At all.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: At the very least, there's no way it was an[n]official Medjed member.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So someone used the Medjed name to[n]provoke the Phantom Thieves? For what[n]purpose?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Could they have been doing it for fun?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It was around the time our group started[n]getting popular, so maybe they wanted in[n]on the hype...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait a moment.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...What if it's the other way around?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hm?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Perhaps they used the Medjed name to[n]make the Phantom Thieves known...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What? That makes no sense.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I actually thought the same as Makoto.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why's that?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Know how I just said that code is like[n]fingerprints?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I found those same fingerprints[n]somewhere completely different.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Where's that?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The Phantom Aficionado Website.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There were traces of it being illegally[n]tampered with from the outside.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Before summer vacation, the access[n]counter was made to be much higher[n]than the actual number.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Same with the rankings. Particularly the[n]time when President Okumura ranked[n]first.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So then, the one who provoked the[n]group and the one who tampered with[n]the site are the same person?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I think I'm starting to see the[n]big picture.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Both Medjed's provocation and the [n]tampering of the website brought[n]attention to us as a result.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: On top of that, our reason for targeting[n]Okumura was influenced by the public[n]and the rankings...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The perfect timing, and the perfect target.[n]If both of those had been set up...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...It would all make sense.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, the culprit was planning to put the[n]blame on us from the start!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No way...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is all hypothetical. We lack any hard[n]evidence...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But if all your deductions happen to be[n]correct...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That would mean we've been playing[n]right into their hand for the past two[n]months or so...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: W-We gotta be overthinkin' things.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, we're talkin' both the rankings[n]AND Medjed!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Everyone made a big deal about it![n]If this was all set up...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then... what kind of guy did we make[n]an enemy of?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...There's no point in getting anxious[n]over speculation.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Regardless, we'll be falsely charged at[n]this rate, and with murder. We must[n]overcome this.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But, we don't even know who we're[n]up against...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey... you think we're fallin' into another[n]trap, even at this very moment?
Calm down.
We don't know yet.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah. This doesn't mean that we've[n]lost yet.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Indeed, we don't. It'll be more dangerous[n]jumping to conclusions and assuming[n]we figured it out.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even if this is the actions of a meticulous[n]enemy, we'll just have to get back at them.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We need to find clues... no matter what.
